cues: With hot, excess H I, the ethanol formed is itself converted into iodoethane, by the same two steps.
Add the two equations, and one ether plus two H I gives two iodoethane and water.
Hydrogen iodide works best, then hydrogen bromide, then hydrogen chloride, following how good the halide ion is as a nucleophile.
